newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron leads in January petroleum sales.
newsitem.headline: Petron leads in January petroleum sales.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp increased its market share to 43.1 percent in January 1997 from 41.7 percent last year, the monthly industry data complied by the country's three oil refiners showed on Monday.

The total oil inland trade data, however, showed total sales volume of the three oil refiners for January 1997 at 10.435 million barrels, 5.2 percent lower than the year-earlier month of 11.011 million barrels.
Industry officials attributed this to the lower use of fuel oil by state-owned National Power Corp with the operation of base-load, coal-fired power plants.
Petron sold a total of 4.496 million barrels in January, 2.1 percent down from 4.595 million barrels last year.

Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp, a unit of Royal Dutch Shell Group, cornered a market share of 31.7 percent in January versus 34.2 percent a year ago. Its sales totalled 3.309 million barrels, 12.1 percent lower than 3.762 million barrels a year ago.

Caltex (Philippines) Inc, a joint venture between Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc, had a share of 24.7 percent compared with 24.1 percent last year. Its sales in January fell by 2.7 percent to 2.583 million barrels from 2.654 million barrels a year ago. - Manila newsroom 63 2 841-8937 fax 8176267
